official.deadline_note: No university-wide CGS Type B deadline exists: each Tsinghua school/department sets its own cutoff and emails recommended candidates. Tsinghua recommends completing the pre-admission application well before mid-December (the 2026-cycle page said before Mid-December 2025). The broader 2027 international graduate application window runs September to February, with batches and deadlines varying by department; the winter break (21 Jan-17 Feb 2027) delays document verification.
official.application_cycle: 2027 admission round (international graduate application period generally September to February); the CGS page still displays the 2026 cycle and states 'Scholarship for 2027 is coming soon'
official.status_note: Tsinghua's 2027 international graduate application is open via the Apply Now portal, but the CGS Type B page as of 11 Oct 2026 still posts the 2026 cycle with the 2027 scholarship marked 'coming soon'; only departments can start the nomination step, so applicants must secure pre-admission early in the window.
official.tuition_coverage_note: 'Full CGS: tuition fees, free university dormitory or accommodation subsidy, stipend, and comprehensive medical insurance.' Tsinghua notes many high-tuition programs do not participate in Type B recommendation, and the exact distribution follows higher-authority policy.
benefits: Free university dormitory or accommodation subsidy
Partial CGS includes one or some items from the Full CGS coverage
eligibility: Citizen of a country other than the People's Republic of China, in good health both mentally and physically

Bachelor's degree holder under 35 when applying for master's programs; master's degree holder under 40 when applying for doctoral programs (bachelor's holders may apply for doctoral-track CGS Type A or B if eligible)

HSK Level 4 when applying for Chinese-taught master's or doctoral programs; holders of a degree from a Chinese university with Chinese-taught instruction provide proof of Chinese-taught instruction instead
Pre-admitted by Tsinghua and recommended for CGS by the pre-admitted school/department - otherwise the application will not be considered or processed
Not offered other scholarships for prospective graduate study at Tsinghua and not nominated as a CGS candidate to the CSC by another university
Meet other CGS Type B requirements such as applicable programs/majors and nationalities, per the scholarship contact of the school/department
requirements: Apply for full-time graduate study at Tsinghua for pre-admission online at https://yzbm.tsinghua.edu.cn/intlLogin
Obtain a recommendation from the pre-admitted school/department; applications without it are not processed
Fill in, submit and download the CGS Online Application form via the CSC System (campuschina.org) when informed by the school/department
Submit all CGS documents online; CGS applicants do not need to mail hard copies to Tsinghua University
Stay reachable by email - unreachable applicants or those who fail to complete the CSC online application in time are treated as renouncing the candidacy
Pass the Annual Review (academic performance, learning attitude, attendance, student conduct, rewards and punishments) each year to continue receiving the scholarship
documents: Chinese Government Scholarship Application form (Attachment 2), submitted online only
Pre-admission result and the school/department recommendation
Documents listed in Attachment 2 of the Tsinghua CGS page
Valid Non-Criminal Record (police clearance) certificate issued usually within 6 months before submission; notarized Chinese or English translation if not in English or Chinese
Foreigner Physical Examination Form covering all items, with attending physician's signature, hospital stamp and sealed photograph; result valid for only 6 months
HSK score report where the programme is Chinese-taught (HSK results valid two years); proof of Chinese-taught instruction exempts applicants holding a Chinese-taught degree
Expected graduation certificate or official student-status proof if the diploma has not yet been awarded
Nationality status documentation per Tsinghua's 2027 Submission Instructions, by the specified deadline
selection_criteria: Tsinghua usually selects CGS candidates from pre-admitted applicants of remarkable merit
Recommendation of the school/department to the University is mandatory and limited in number per year
The CSC organizes designated universities and experts to examine eligibility and academic performance before finalizing the short list
Annual Review of scholarship status is strictly required each year; failure suspends or terminates the scholarship
coverage: Free university dormitory or accommodation subsidy
application_method: Step 1: apply for graduate pre-admission at Tsinghua and obtain the school/department recommendation (highly recommended before mid-December)
Step 2: complete the CSC system online application and download the CGS form when instructed by the school/department
Step 4: Tsinghua selects candidates and nominates them to the CSC
Step 5: CSC expert review and approval; results are notified to Tsinghua, usually released in July to August
official.application_route: Apply on Tsinghua's international graduate application portal, win pre-admission plus a school/department recommendation, then complete the CGS online application in the CSC system when invited - there is no direct standalone CGS application.
official.citizenship_residency: Applicants must be foreign nationals under PRC Nationality Law holding a valid foreign passport; former Chinese citizens must have held foreign nationality for at least 6 years as of 30 April of the enrollment year, and applicants born abroad to settled Chinese-citizen parents must meet the permanent-residence condition
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the scholarship is exclusively for citizens of countries other than the People's Republic of China; applicants holding other scholarships for prospective Tsinghua graduate study or CSC nominations from other universities are excluded
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: CGS Type B is administered by Chinese universities under the CGS-Chinese University Program (e.g. CGS High-Level Postgraduate Program); Type A (bilateral, EU, AUN programs) is handled by embassies or other authorities instead. Type B is not open to joint-degree graduate programs, and many high-tuition programs do not participate in the Type B recommendation
official.research_requirement: PhD applicants must upload a brief research experience or research plan with the pre-admission application
official.duration: Master's degree: 1-3 years. Doctoral degree: 4-5 years
official.description: The Chinese Government Scholarship is set up by the Chinese government and administered by the China Scholarship Council, entrusted by the Ministry of Education with admission, enrollment and administration of recipients. Through the Tsinghua Type B route, the university nominates pre-admitted applicants of remarkable merit under the CGS-Chinese University Program, and the CSC makes the final decision after expert review.
official.program_type: Chinese Government Scholarship Program Category Type B (CGS-Chinese University Program) nominated by Tsinghua University to the China Scholarship Council
official.english_requirement: No CGS-wide IELTS/TOEFL figure is published: applicants' Chinese or English proficiency must meet the requirements announced by the relevant school/department in the Remarks of Application of the Catalog of Graduate Programs 2027; Chinese-taught master's or doctoral applicants need HSK Level 4 as required by the scholarship

verification.notes: Coverage items, eligibility, five-step procedure, deadline guidance and required documents were verified on Tsinghua's official CGS Type B page, scholarship FAQ, Financial Aid System page and 2027 How to Apply page; campuschina.org, the CSC channel that publishes the monthly stipend figure, returned HTTP 412 on every attempt, so no amount is recorded and the fields are left null.

applicant_utility.summary: Nobody can apply for CGS Type B directly: you must first submit Tsinghua's international graduate application through the official portal, earn pre-admission, and then persuade your department to recommend you, because unrecommended files are never processed. Since departments set their own cutoffs (often closing before mid-December) and slots are scarce and merit-driven, finishing the admission file in September or October gives you the only realistic path to a nomination. Even after nomination the CSC makes the final decision, with results typically arriving in July-August, and the scholarship must be renewed every year through the Annual Review.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Strong pre-admitted candidates for a participating, non-joint-degree, standard-tuition Tsinghua master's or PhD program, comfortable with the published language requirements and long document lead times
application_readiness_checklist: Create the pre-admission application on yzbm.tsinghua.edu.cn/intlLogin early in the September-February window so a department can still open a recommendation slot for you
Start CSCSE (or CSSD for mainland-Chinese degrees) degree authentication as soon as degree certificates are available - it gates the whole file
Book the Foreigner Physical Examination within the 6-month validity window and confirm the form has every item, the physician's signature, hospital stamp and sealed photo
Request the Non-Criminal Record certificate from your local public security authority within 6 months of submission, with notarized translation if it is not in Chinese or English
Secure HSK Level 4 or better for Chinese-taught targets (results valid two years) or confirm the department's published English requirement for English-medium programs
Line up two referees at associate professor level or above and give them portal links well ahead of the deadline
Scan everything in color on a scanner, with original and certified translation together, and save an electronic copy of every uploaded file
common_rejection_risks: Missing the department's own CGS recommendation deadline, which can pass before mid-December and is only communicated by email
Being unreachable by email or missing the CSC system step after nomination - Tsinghua treats this as renouncing the candidacy
Targeting a joint-degree program or a high-tuition program that does not participate in Type B recommendation
Holding or negotiating another scholarship for prospective Tsinghua study, or being nominated by a second university - CSC blocks double nominations
Being an already-enrolled student: Type B is open to prospective students only, and failing to win CGS this year means you cannot switch to Type B later
Falsified or non-truthful information, or substantive integrity breaches, which lead to cancelled admission by Tsinghua's published rules
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The application fee is paid by you and is explicitly not covered by the Chinese Government Scholarship, and it is non-refundable whether or not you are admitted. If on-campus housing is not obtained, off-campus rent is on you (the free dormitory benefit assumes a room you secure). Anything beyond the stipend - travel to China is not a published benefit - plus the RMB 800/year accidental injury and hospitalization insurance on Tsinghua's expense list for students not covered by scholarship insurance, and personal study costs, remain self-funded.
document_audit: Phone or camera photos of documents are rejected - color scanner images only
Any document not in Chinese or English must appear as both the original and a notarized certified translation
The physical examination and the police clearance both lapse in 6 months, and the HSK report in 2 years, so timing the exam matters as much as the marks
Pre-graduation applicants upload an expected-graduation certificate, but the authenticated degree must arrive before the 2027 registration date or the admission is void
Nationality status documentation is due by its own hard deadline with no supplementary materials accepted after the application period closes
alerts: As of 11 October 2026 the official CGS page still shows the 2026 cycle with 'Scholarship for 2027 coming soon' - do not wait for a CGS announcement, the department recommendation clock starts with the admission application
The 21 January - 17 February 2027 winter break slows verification, so submit at least 2-3 weeks early
Results typically land July-August, so visa, funding and job plans that assume an earlier answer are a real risk
The scholarship is re-earned each year via the Annual Review; failed reviews suspend or terminate funding mid-study

Tsinghua states it never works with intermediary agencies - only the official portal and department contacts are legitimate, and fake CSC admission notices demanding deposits have circulated in the past
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Online only: build the file on the Tsinghua international portal, pay the fee at submission, then complete the CSC system form by invitation and wait for Tsinghua's admission package, which carries the CSC result.
